title: Quick input (Command Palette / Quick Open)
description: The quick input widget: filter box above a list of <vsc-quick-pick-item>s. Used by the Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) and Quick Open (Ctrl+P).
usage: Inside <vsc-workbench> (it floats 6px below the top, centered). Set position="static" to lay it out inline. Children: <vsc-quick-pick-item>.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.default: Type the name of a command to run.

examples.title: Quick Open (recent files)
examples.html: <vsc-quick-input position="static" placeholder="Search files by name (append : to go to line or @ to go to symbol), or paste a link"><vsc-quick-pick-item label="package.json" file description="" separator="recently opened" focused><vsc-action slot="actions" icon="split-horizontal" label="Open to the Side"></vsc-action><vsc-action slot="actions" icon="close" label="Remove from Recently Opened" focusable="false"></vsc-action></vsc-quick-pick-item><vsc-quick-pick-item label="README.md" file description=""><vsc-action slot="actions" icon="split-horizontal" label="Open to the Side"></vsc-action><vsc-action slot="actions" icon="close" label="Remove from Recently Opened" focusable="false"></vsc-action></vsc-quick-pick-item></vsc-quick-input>
